login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in with your email address and password.
login.consent: By continuing, you agree to the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
login.callbackError: This link has expired or has already been used. Please start again.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.intro: Choose a username. This is the name your neighbors will see.
signup.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, including one letter and one number.
signup.checkEmail: Account created. Open the confirmation email sent to {email} to activate it, then sign in.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your email address. If an account exists, we’ll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account matches {email}, an email has been sent. Open the link on this device.

reset.title: New password
reset.expired: The reset link has expired. Request a new one.

errors.email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email address using the link we sent you.
errors.password_too_weak: Use at least one letter and one number.
errors.same_password: Choose a password different from your current one.
errors.signup_failed: Could not create an account with this email. If you already have an account, sign in.

welcome.title: Choose a username
welcome.intro: This is the name your neighbors will see. 3–20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, or “_”.

required.title: Sign in required
required.body: Sign in to record, react, or report.
